limitations: Complex characteristic zero; only lines rich in order-two quasi-Galois centres; the quartic plane-curve case and general Fermat bitangents have classical precursors; no classification of all tangent lines or tangent hyperplanes; independent historical-priority and mathematical audit outstanding.
scientific_integrity: The all-degree claim is proved mathematically; exact finite-degree rational polynomial checks corroborate only bounded cases. The motivating centre-classification result and known quartic multiple-tangencies are cited, not represented as new. No independent validation has occurred.
source_ids: Oka 2014 lecture slides: On Fermat curves and maximal nodal curves
title: Degree-mod-three tangency dichotomy for quasi-Galois three-centre lines of Fermat hypersurfaces
